tested_condition: Reusable UI primitives can be introduced without replacing placeholder routes with final page implementations.
expected_outcome: Component system is ready to support Phase3 page assembly.
actual_outcome: Shared shell, navigation, footer, framed section, signal card, and placeholder composition primitives were created or updated so existing route placeholders inherit the design system without route-level edits.
passes: Reusable component surface expanded beyond the initial shell placeholder.
Placeholder routes can benefit from the new system through existing imports only.
No final page materialization was introduced.

component_purpose_map.site-shell: Applies system-level backdrop, header framing, and shell messaging.
component_purpose_map.site-footer: Provides a reusable footer band consistent with the system rhythm.
component_purpose_map.section-frame: Creates bordered, padded content sections for later page assembly.
component_purpose_map.placeholder-page: Demonstrates the system using non-final placeholder compositions.
